place-value.base-ten.note: Base-ten place value of whole numbers spans the ten as a unit, two-digit tens and ones, the hundred as a unit, three-digit digit values, the general ten-times relation, and expanded form; these are different levels and tests. Re-point each old edge to the finest node its source actually uses: two-digit work to place-value.two-digit.tens-ones, three-digit work to place-value.three-digit.hundreds-tens-ones, multi-digit algorithms to place-value.ten-times-right or place-value.expanded-form.

multiplication.properties.note: Three or more separate properties; an edge pointing at the group should point at the one property it uses. The strategy nodes (multiplication.commutative.strategy, multiplication.associative.strategy, multiplication.distributive.strategy, division.distributive.strategy) are the applications.

factors-multiples.whole-number.note: The reserved description also names common multiples, GCF and LCM (6.NS.B.4); those are not in this strand's input and must be written by the strand that owns 6.NS.B.4. Edges that need GCF or LCM should be re-pointed to those later nodes, not to these.

addition.whole-number.note: Covers addition beyond 20 only. Addition within 10 and within 20 belongs to other strands; old edges meaning small-number addition must be re-pointed there. Edges meaning 'can add multi-digit numbers' most likely want addition.standard-algorithm or addition.base-ten.strategy.

subtraction.whole-number.note: Covers subtraction beyond 20 only; within 10 and within 20 belong to other strands. Edges meaning 'can subtract multi-digit numbers' most likely want subtraction.standard-algorithm or subtraction.base-ten.strategy.

multiplication.multi-digit.note: Spans place-value strategies and the standard algorithm, which are different nodes by rule 6. Most old edges probably want multiplication.standard-algorithm (computing a product) or a partial-products node.

division.multi-digit.note: Spans exact quotients and remainders, one- and two-digit divisors. The standard long-division algorithm for whole numbers is 6.NS.B.2 (later phase); edges that mean fluent long division should wait for that node.

decimal.operations.note: Four operations, each with a model node and a relate-to-written node. The fluent decimal standard algorithms are 6.NS.B.3 (later phase); old edges that mean symbolic decimal computation should be re-pointed to those when written.
